This commit message:
1. Uses "feat" type since it introduces new functionality
2. Specifies "local-model" scope as the changes are focused on this feature
3. Provides a concise description under 50 characters
4. Includes a body that highlights the key changes without repeating the subject
5. Uses imperative mood and avoids periods
6. Focuses on the significant functional changes rather than listing every file modification

feat(localmodel): enhance local model version list display

- Add namespace prefix to model display names for better identification
- Update table headers to show source model display with namespace
- Add action menu and styling for grouped resources
- Hide namespace group button in resource table configuration
- Update translation for model label to be more specific

feat(localmodel): add local model version support with caching functionality

- Introduce new local model version type and related components
- Add caching action to models for creating local versions
- Implement create local model version modal dialog
- Add translations and UI elements for local model management
- Update navigation and product configuration for new resource type

docs(translations): add 'globalSettings' key to en-us.yaml

Add the 'globalSettings' key to the English translations file to support the new global settings feature in the UI

feat(i18n): add translations for file management UI

Add translations for file management UI components in both English and Chinese. This includes labels and messages for actions like create folder, download, add file, upload folder, and file deletion confirmation. The changes ensure consistent localization across the application.

feat(modelRegistry): add support for default registry selection

Enable users to select a default registry for models and datasets. This includes adding a new translation key, updating model and dataset classes to handle default registry logic, and modifying the UI to display and manage default registry options. The changes ensure that when a user selects "Use the default Registry", the system automatically assigns the default registry ID to the resource.
feat: add app menus

fix(dataset): improve version sorting and display logic

Refactor the version sorting logic to correctly handle version names starting with 'v'. Update the display logic to show only the first part of the version name. Add a success message after dataset version creation.

refactor(registry): update UI and configurations for registry management

Simplify the UI by hiding unnecessary elements and adjust configurations to better support registry management. This includes updating translation files, modifying layout components, and reorganizing type definitions to improve maintainability and user experience.

feat(translations): add dataset version inheritance labels

Add translation labels for dataset version inheritance in both English and Chinese. This includes labels for inheritance and new modes, along with their descriptions. Additionally, clean up unused variables in the upload functions and update the metadata generation in the dataset version creation modal.

feat: add Tensorflow support and update dataset options

Add Tensorflow as a supported model framework in ml.llmos.ai.model.vue. Update dataset options in ml.llmos.ai.dataset.vue to use centralized dictionaries for licenses, languages, and ML features. Correct SSL label to Https in translations.

feat(dataset): add dataset versioning and file management

Introduce new dataset versioning feature allowing users to create new versions of datasets with options for data inheritance or starting fresh. Additionally, implement file management functionality for datasets, including file upload, download, and folder creation. This enhances dataset management capabilities and improves user workflow.
